evals.prompt: Pick a theme for this deck
evals.expected_output: Selects an appropriate theme from the bundled presets or Claude Design bundles and resolves it for the downstream renderer

evals.prompt: Our brand colors are #0F4C81 and #F5A623 — build me a theme around those
evals.expected_output: Creates a theme from the supplied palette and audits it for contrast and palette harmony before applying it

evals.prompt: Is the theme we're using accessible?
evals.expected_output: Audits the active theme for contrast ratios, typography pairing and completeness, reporting each failing check
